_comment: The six, SPEC.md §5. A trooper's role picks his base numbers out of data/rules.json; his `traits` are ids from data/traits.json that modify those numbers through the hook system. Nothing in code reads a trooper by name (CLAUDE.md rule 6). A seventh trooper is one more entry here plus one more start hex in data/map.json (until the drop replaces start hexes at M6).
_leader: `leader` marks the ranking man. It picks his counter frame and makes him the source of the command radius in data/rules.json. It is a flag, not a name, so promoting someone else is a one-line edit here.
_shortName: What fits on the counter's name strip. It is not required to be the surname: Holloway goes by his nickname.
_dialogue: Three lines every man must have, keyed onLand, onPlaceCharge, onWounded (SPEC.md §5), even a man who will never place a charge. The rest are optional, and a man without one is silent. onWoundedCarrying: said instead of onWounded when he is hit still carrying a charge, which then drops on his hex, so a line about the charge is only said when there is one to fetch; give it to the men who start with charges, and onWounded must then not mention one. onKill: after a gunner's kill or anyone's knife. onSpotted: the first time he is seen, not each turn he stays in view. onHide: going to ground. These are PLACEHOLDER lines, written to be replaced.

dialogue.onWounded: Only a scratch. Keep the lads moving.
dialogue.onWoundedCarrying: Charge is by my boots. Somebody fetch it and I'll catch up.
dialogue.onKill: One less to worry about. Now keep your heads down.
dialogue.onHide: Get down and stay down. That's an order.

dialogue.onWoundedCarrying: Oh, that's torn it. Charge is on the deck — mind how you lift it.
dialogue.onSpotted: Uh-oh... He's looking right at me.
dialogue.onHide: Nice and snug here in the dirt.

dialogue.onLand: This is a fine spot Sarge.
dialogue.onPlaceCharge: Not my trade, this. Hope it goes bang.
dialogue.onWounded: Should've kept my head down damn it. Go on, I'll catch up.
dialogue.onKill: Didn't hear a thing, did he?
dialogue.onSpotted: Spotted. I'll have to be quick about it.

dialogue.onLand: Missed every tree in France. Told you I would.
dialogue.onWounded: Leave it. Get to the bridge.
dialogue.onKill: Hope nobody was fond of him.
dialogue.onHide: Down in the mud, where I belong.

dialogue.onLand: Bren's in one piece. That's all that matters.
dialogue.onPlaceCharge: Don't ask me to do that again.
dialogue.onWounded: Bit of bother. Still got one good arm.
dialogue.onSpotted: Been made. Somebody sort this bloke out.

dialogue.onLand: All the way down in one piece, Sarge.
dialogue.onPlaceCharge: Heavy old thing. Glad to be done with it.
dialogue.onWounded: Takes more than that to put me out of business.
dialogue.onSpotted: Bit hard to hide a man my size.
dialogue.onHide: Small as I can make myself. Which ain't small.
